bibliographic.title: A Totally Normal Check-up
bibliographic.author: SquareHair
bibliographic.description:
You're at your doctor's office for a check-up.

It's a totally normal check-up.

Only... you're not a very normal patient.

Do you remember where you are?

Do you remember what happened?

Do you remember what you are?

A tiny interactive fiction game for the Bare-Bones Jam (2024). There are 3 possible endings.

Made on Twine, using Sugarcube.

Thumbnail made using ASCII text art through the Text to ASCII Art Maker by the ASCII Art Archive.
